fixture: Seeded shuffle of all30 champions into10 squads; five opposing squad pairs; three cyclic deployments; default and all48-spell catalog loadout profiles; two related public-state policies; paired exchanged seats. 120 games, no parameter tuning.
limitations: Seeded fixtures cover every identity and equip every spell but only five squad pairings and three deployment permutations. They do not cover all team/loadout matchups.
Seat symmetry verifies engine and policy invariants. These related shallow bots do not prove human balance, strategic depth, enjoyable pacing, browser performance or commercial potential.
Spells equipped but not cast reflect AI limitations. Every spell has a separate legal-resolution test; neither check proves every tactical interaction.
